carrier_stage: DRV8962-Q1: three half-bridges (motor common, left, right) and the fourth channel's low FET as the clutch sink (D-360, D-379); stall current still W-332's. Fed from logic 12 V (DP-DCU 1), on the expander, asleep through a reset (D-452). The real 44-pin part also has VCC (tied to DVDD, no separate logic supply), MODE and OCPM to set, IPROPI2-4 and PGND1-4, and three pins per OUT - the sheet must carry them (Y3, S-486)

note: luxury D-359 supersedes D-326: the DCU drives the mirrors. Input is the panel thumbstick (LP35): two analog axes + press to toggle LEFT/RIGHT. An axis picks the clutch state, its direction picks the motor polarity. The mirrors do not move with the DCU down - accepted in D-359
